paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang huanghang ate bang sek nawn inla, tang ah ka kiang ah hong pai inla, singkuang bawl in.
heading: Mosi In Thupiakte Ala Nawn / (Eks 34.1-10)

paite: Tuma lam a suangpek na hihkhapte a thu tuangte suangpekte ah ka gelh dia, singkuang ah na koih ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in singgi sing in singkuang ka bawl a, tuma lam a bang suangpek nih ka sek a, suangpek nihte tawi in tang ah ka hohtou hi.
Suangpekte ah ama a gelh bang, na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua agen thupiak sawm agelh a, TOUPA'N ahon pia hi.
Tang a pan ka kiheisuk nawn a, ka singkuang bawl ah suangpek ka koih hi. TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Israel suante Bene-jaakan tuileh a pan Moserah ah apai ua; huai ah Aaron asi a, huai ah avui uhi. Atapa Eleazar in amun ah siampu nna asem hi.
Huai a pan Gudgodah ah apai ua; Gudgodah a pan tuiluite gam Jotbathah ah apai uhi.
Huai lai in tutan a TOUPA thukhun singkuang zawng a, ama a TOUPA nna sem a, amin a vualzawlsakmi hi ding in Levi chi aseptuam hi.
Huaiziak in Levi in a-unaute lak ah tantuan, goutan anei kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian un akiang a agen bang in TOUPA agoutan ahi.
Amalam mah bang in tang ah, ni sawmli ka om a; huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu angaikhia a, TOUPA'N nou hon hihmangthang kei hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, mipite ma kai in; amaute piak dia api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam gam aluah ding uh ahi," achi hi.

Khai le, Israel mite aw, nou a pan TOUPA na Pathian un ahon phut bangdang ahia, na hoihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam a, alampi tengteng tawn a, amah it a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem a,
heading: Pathian In Aphut

paite: TOUPA thupiakte, adante zuih dia tua thu ka hon piak zuih hilou maw?
Ngai un, van leh van sangpente leh lei leh asung a om tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh a vek ahi.
Himahleh na pi-le-pute it bel amah kipah lam ahi a, namdang tengteng tung ah noute, amau nung a asuante uh tua na hih mah bang un hon na telta hi.
Huaiziak in na lungtang vun uh sum unla, genhak nawn kei un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh lah pathiante' Pathian, toupate' Toupa, Pathian thupitak, hattak, lauhuaitak, kuamah deihsak tuam nei lou a, golhna leng la ngei lou ahi ngal a.
Pa neiloute leh meithaite hoihtak in vai ahawmsak hi.
Huaiziak in gamdang mite it sam un; nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua; amah na len tinten ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
Amah na phat dingpa uh ahi, hiai na mit ua na muh khitsa uh thil thupitak leh mulkimhuaitakte hon hihsakpa na Pathian uh ahi.
Na pi-le-pute uh Aigupta gam ah mi sawmsagih apaisuk ua; tu in bel tamlam in van a aksi zah in TOUPA na Pathian un ahon tamsakta hi.
